shared_elements: boat- or crescent-shaped form (A) vs curved scroll forms (B)
justification: A shows sparse, stick-like schematic figures, cup marks and boat/crescent shapes scattered loosely over an open rock surface, while B shows a single frontal, richly costumed standing figure densely enveloped in interlocking scroll and mask ornament within a bounded upright field. Beyond the trivially generic presence of humanoid forms and curved lines, there is no shared motif, relationship or compositional scheme.
